\section[la couleur]{la couleur — a colour}

\label{lesson:FR-C129-couleur}



\begin{quote}
Before the new one: say the French for life, then the French for a time.

Ask for the colour: \emph{Quelle couleur ?} \textbf{Quel} takes an -le before a feminine noun.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{You'll want to know: la couleur}
